```yaml
name: Azure Deployment

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main

jobs:
  build-and-deploy:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
    - name: Checkout code
      uses: actions/checkout@v2

    - name: Set up Python
      uses: actions/setup-python@v2
      with:
        python-version: '3.8'

    - name: Install dependencies
      run: |
        python -m pip install --upgrade pip
        pip install -r requirements.txt

    - name: Run tests
      run: |
        pytest

    - name: Deploy to Azure
      uses: azure/login@v1
      with:
        creds: ${{ secrets.AZURE_CREDENTIALS }}

      - name: Build Docker image
        run: docker build . -t kouchou-ai:latest

      - name: Push Docker image to Azure Container Registry
        run: |
          az acr login --name kouchouaiacr
          docker tag kouchou-ai:latest kouchouaiacr.azurecr.io/kouchou-ai:latest
          docker push kouchouaiacr.azurecr.io/kouchou-ai:latest

      - name: Deploy to Azure App Service
        uses: azure/webapps-deploy@v2
        with:
          app-name: kouchou-ai-app
          slot-name: production
          package: .
```

This GitHub Actions workflow file `.github/workflows/azure-deploy.yml` automates the deployment of your Python application to Azure App Service whenever changes are pushed to the `main` branch. It includes steps for checking out the code, setting up Python, installing dependencies, running tests, logging into Azure, building a Docker image, pushing the Docker image to Azure Container Registry, and finally deploying the application to Azure App Service. Make sure you have the necessary secrets (`AZURE_CREDENTIALS`) configured in your repository settings for this workflow to function correctly.
yaml:
name: Azure Deployment

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main

jobs:
  build-and-deploy:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
    - name: Checkout code
      uses: actions/checkout@v2

    - name: Set up Python
      uses: actions/setup-python@v2
      with:
        python-version: '3.8'

    - name: Install dependencies
      run: |
        python -m pip install --upgrade pip
        pip install -r requirements.txt

    - name: Run tests
      run: |
        pytest

    - name: Deploy to Azure
      uses: azure/login@v1
      with:
        creds: ${{ secrets.AZURE_CREDENTIALS }}

      - name: Build Docker image
        run: docker build . -t kouchou-ai:latest

      - name: Push Docker image to Azure Container Registry
        run: |
          az acr login --name kouchouaiacr
          docker tag kouchou-ai:latest kouchouaiacr.azurecr.io/kouchou-ai:latest
          docker push kouchouaiacr.azurecr.io/kouchou-ai:latest

      - name: Deploy to Azure App Service
        uses: azure/webapps-deploy@v2
        with:
          app-name: kouchou-ai-app
          slot-name: production
          package: .
